content_blocks.text: This policy describes what information is collected through jorarebooks.com and how it's used. Last updated September 2026.

content_blocks.heading: Information we collect
content_blocks.text: When you submit an inquiry through this site, we collect the name, email address, and any message you provide. This information is used only to respond to your inquiry — it is not sold, rented, or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

content_blocks.heading: How inquiries are handled
content_blocks.text: Inquiry submissions are processed through Netlify Forms, the form service used to run this site. No payment or financial information is collected through this site.

content_blocks.heading: Cookies and analytics
content_blocks.text: This site does not use advertising trackers or third-party ad networks.

content_blocks.heading: Contact
content_blocks.text: Questions about this policy can be sent to jeremy@jorarebooks.com.

content_blocks.heading: Changes to this policy
content_blocks.text: This policy may be updated from time to time. The date above reflects the most recent revision.
